_about: wowui check (wow-ui-harness, tests/vendor/wow-ui-harness/python/check.py): the static safety lint CI runs. The rules follow AGENTS.md, "Game API rules"; the allowed globals are those in docs/API.md and .luacheckrc. Suppress a single finding with `-- wowui-check: ignore <rule> <reason>`. Not expressible here, so left to review: secure templates (a template name passed to CreateFrame), changes to the game's font objects (methods called on GameFontNormal and the like), slash commands registered through AceConsole's RegisterChatCommand (tests/test_gamepad.lua covers those), and calls made through pcall, a table field or a computed name.
_disable: Tests and the mock define the fake client API as globals and register into UISpecialFrames on purpose; tools are development scripts that never load in game.

new-global._allow: docs/API.md, "Public API" and "Other globals"; .luacheckrc keeps the same list for luacheck.

file-length._overrides: Addon code stays under 800 lines (AGENTS.md, "Keep files under ~800 lines"). Two UI files are past that and capped at about their size until they are split: they may not grow. Translation tables keep one string per line; development tools never ship. Tests are off (disable above); the vendored harness and libraries are excluded. The first matching glob wins.

unguarded-registration._guard: With the gamepad interface style on, a slash command freezes the client and the gamepad menus close the frames in UISpecialFrames (docs/COMPATIBILITY.md); every registration asks Compat.Gamepad first.
